title: 文鳥・夏目漱石
rights_basis: Exact Aozora Bunko No.753 source bytes were fetched and SHA-256 pinned. Production's three current episodes cryptographically match ordered slices of the normalized Aozora text after whitespace normalization, covering 98.554% of the candidate display text; unmatched material is outside the three Production episode slices and is not treated as proof of additional content. Natsume Soseki died in 1916 and the work first appeared in 1908. Japan: the author's term expired long before the 2018 extension and was not revived. United States: even if URAA restoration had applied, a 1908 pre-1978 publication's full 95-year term would have expired. South Korea: the Japanese source-country term has expired and Article 3(4) does not recognize a longer Korean term for a foreign work once the source-country term has expired. Scope is the exact Aozora transcription only.

No cover, illustrations, commentary, publisher layout, or other separately protected edition material is intentionally reused. Production series ID is preserved by the migration.
